name: Required Reservation Fields
natural_language: Every reservation on a given rate must record the guest's email, phone and identification number.

population.description: Non-cancelled reservations on the rate codes the hotel nominates, arriving from today onward.

minihotel.call_cost: O(1) - IncludeRoomPrices is required or rate_code is absent and scope cannot be resolved

scope.note: Which rate categories carry the requirement is the HOTEL's policy, not the provider's data. v1 carried the literal placeholder ['<hotel-nominated rate codes>'] inside an otherwise executable rule; it is now tenant configuration, and an empty list excludes every record honestly.

execution.rationale: Type A. Guest details change only through reservation events.

freshness_requirement.rationale: Usually a compliance or registration requirement with a deadline at check-in, not immediate.

unknown_conditions.reason: cannot determine whether the reservation is in scope, so neither PASS nor FAIL is justified

caveats: The company half of the original control is NOT expressible: MiniHotel has no company or corporate account entity anywhere in its API. Only guest and payment fields can be asserted.
Payment card fields are masked/tokenised, so presence can be asserted but never validity.
